description: Machine-readable ledger of all identified spec authority bypass paths — ways a PRODUCT_SOURCE item can pass all gates with zero real spec authority

bypass_paths.title: Zero-fact format gap reference satisfies TC-GUARD-001
bypass_paths.mechanism: TC-GUARD-001 checks gap_ledger_ref PRESENCE only. A PRODUCT_SOURCE item citing a Gnumeric/ABW gap satisfies the gate despite 0 workbench SAL facts.
bypass_paths.evidence: autonomous_cycle.py Step 2d3: checks 'if not (has_gap_ref or has_cap_ref or has_spec_fact_refs)' — no authority depth check
bypass_paths.repair: Add advisory depth check to TC-GUARD-001 when format has 0 workbench facts

bypass_paths.title: CSV stale spec_facts create false appearance of spec backing in gap-ledger
bypass_paths.mechanism: 58 CSV gap entries have spec_facts: ['FACT-CSV-001', 'FACT-CSV-002']. These IDs are not in sal-facts-latest.json (CSV has 0 workbench facts). A system reading gap.spec_facts to verify authority would find apparent references that lead nowhere.
bypass_paths.evidence: python -c "import json; g=json.load(open('reports/capability-layer/gap-ledger.json')); csv=[x for x in g['gaps'] if x.get('format')=='CSV' and x.get('spec_facts')]; print(len(csv))" → 58
bypass_paths.repair: Clear spec_facts for all CSV gap entries

bypass_paths.title: Bootstrap template facts in GAP-INT-002 fact index
bypass_paths.mechanism: GAP-INT-002 builds its fact index from sal-facts-latest.json in DEFAULT mode. Index includes bootstrap-only template facts (e.g., ODF-FACT-NAMESPACE). A product source citing a template fact ID would pass test_total_fact_refs_across_product_source.
bypass_paths.evidence: sal-facts-latest.json: FODS has 22 bootstrap_only facts alongside 4987 workbench_verified
bypass_paths.repair: Switch SAL daily output to from_cache_only=True; add source filter to _load_sal_facts()

bypass_paths.title: Healing gate passes despite zero workbench facts for any format
bypass_paths.mechanism: check_system_healing_gate.py Lane 1 checks fods_facts_gte_10 and fodt_facts_gte_10 only. Gate passes even if Gnumeric, ABW, CSV have 0 workbench facts. Since gate is also ADVISORY (Step 1b), even if Lane 1 failed it would not block the sprint.
bypass_paths.evidence: healing gate output: lane_results[0].checks.fods_facts_gte_10: true — passes trivially
bypass_paths.repair: Add workbench_verified_count_positive criterion to Lane 1; upgrade gate to ENFORCING

bypass_paths.title: SAL pipeline is advisory — autonomous_cycle never reads spec facts
bypass_paths.mechanism: The entire SAL pipeline output (sal-facts-latest.json) is not read by autonomous_cycle.py. TC-GUARD-001 requires gap_ledger_ref but does not verify the gap has spec-backed facts. Even if every format had 0 workbench facts, all sprints would proceed.
bypass_paths.repair: Minimal integration: read sal-facts-latest.json in Step 1c; emit advisory per-format warnings
